ovarian_hgsoc::prognostic::riester2014_p.interpretation: Riester et al. OV survival signature, reproduced as an elastic-net Cox risk score (frozen on MetaGxOvarian:TCGAOVARIAN, n=521, 281 events; 5-fold out-of-fold C-index 0.539). Applied UNCHANGED to two INDEPENDENT GEO cohorts (0 patient overlap with training): in GSE9891 (n=268, 113 events) the score is prognostic (C-index 0.625, HR/SD 1.36, p=0.001); in GSE32062 (n=257, 120 events) it is NULL (C-index 0.509, HR/SD 0.97, p=0.758). Replication is therefore INCONSISTENT across independent cohorts, and the proportional-hazards assumption is violated in both (PH p=0.045 and p=0.025). A same-cohort reprocessing of the training data is a sensitivity check only, not replication. VERDICT: discovery-only — not a validated prognostic classifier. RESEARCH USE ONLY — not validated for clinical decision-making.
caveats: External replication is inconsistent: signal present in GSE9891 but absent in GSE32062.
Proportional-hazards assumption violated in both independent cohorts (time-varying effect).
Only 3 of 18 signature genes survived elastic-net penalisation on the training cohort.
Same-cohort reprocessing (TCGA) is a sensitivity check, never external replication.

ovarian_hgsoc::diagnostic::consensusOV_d.interpretation: consensusOV (Chen et al.) HGSOC molecular-subtype classifier, run UNCHANGED across 2 independent cohorts (TCGAOVARIAN, GSE9891). Subtype mixtures are reported per cohort; cross-cohort total-variation distance between subtype mixtures is 0.025 (lower = more transportable mixture). Because patients are not shared across these studies, concordance is distributional, not per-patient. Subtype calls are composition-aware, not intrinsic epithelial subtype. Shipped discovery-only. RESEARCH USE ONLY — not validated for clinical decision-making.
caveats: Patients are NOT shared across GSE9891 and TCGAOVARIAN (different studies), so subtype concordance is assessed at the DISTRIBUTIONAL level (total variation distance between subtype mixtures), not per-patient agreement.

HGSOC transcriptomic subtypes are partly driven by tumor cellular composition and TME (Geistlinger 2020, Cancer Res; Tanis 2026). Subtype calls are labelled composition-aware, not intrinsic epithelial subtype. Kruskal-Wallis tests report whether subtype tracks tumor/stromal content in each cohort.
ovarian_hgsoc::diagnostic::consensusOV_d.labeling: RESEARCH USE ONLY. Not validated for clinical decision-making.

ovarian_hgsoc::prognostic::ownpanel_pi3k.interpretation: Our in-repo pi3k_mtor panel scored as an unsupervised mean-z prognostic signature across 4 independent OV cohorts. C-indices cluster near 0.5, i.e. weak-to-null prognostic signal; the panel is NOT a validated prognostic biomarker. Discovery-only. RESEARCH USE ONLY — not validated for clinical decision-making.
caveats: W4 is a DISCOVERY scan of our own panels; even 'candidate_replicated' stays discovery-only until formally frozen + prospectively externally validated.
All W4 results are DISCOVERY-ONLY. Unsupervised mean-z panel scores, not outcome-fitted models. No panel here is a validated prognostic biomarker.
